title: Photographing our brand
slide_intent: Teach photographers to show the machine at the point where it does its work. A toolhead, substrate and trace in one frame can tell the viewer what a machine is for.
strategic_value: Voltera can communicate its industrial purpose through the action in the photograph. Blue and green details against neutral materials can connect an operating machine to the brand palette.
demonstration: A tall detail photograph shows an illuminated toolhead above a trace on a reflective work surface. The adjacent guidance favors machines in action, orderly settings and mostly neutral colors with blue or green accents.
practical_value: Choose a frame that includes the working part and the material it acts on. Use the guide’s examples of a workbench mat or circuit board to source color from the working environment.

content_islands.name: Contents rail
content_islands.spec: Mark Photography in the dark left contents column and put page 17 in a blue tab at the lower right.

content_islands.name: Machine action
content_islands.spec: Place a full-height photograph between the contents and text. Keep the tip, work surface, trace and reflection in view. Use the mix of metallic neutrals and colored light to carry the image.

content_islands.name: Photo selection
content_islands.spec: In the right column place the Photography section label, green accent and page title. Follow with guidance to show machines in use when communicating capabilities.

content_islands.name: Shooting guidance
content_islands.spec: Group practical instructions below the selection note. Cover background order, lighting, blue or green accents, machine details and the condition of components and substrates.
